summary: SHOP website-to-native CMS parity, end to end. Backend: 9/9 pytest pass. GET /api/homepage returns a 16-hex `version` and `updated_at` with Cache-Control no-cache. /homepage/version returns the same version. The version changes after config, title, is_enabled, reorder, create and delete. Native Expo preview at 390x844 renders the 5 CMS sections in display_order with the expected testIDs, in French by default (hero headline, 'Acheter par catégorie' with sub-category counts, 'Nouveautés', 'Moins de 10 000 XOF', 'Marques en vedette'). It matches the website /shop at 390 for order, text and images. Add-to-cart from the rail works (header-cart-count=1, cart bar shows). Live-sync tests passed on both clients at the same time: banner headline_fr + image + image_mobile change (native and website at 390 both used image_mobile), category/products reorder, disabling under_10k, and a new promo at display_order 15 rendered second. All CMS data was restored and checked by exact config diff; the TEST_ promo was deleted. EN toggle passes: Shop by category / Fresh drops / Fashion, tech & home / Browse categories. Foreground version check passes: a PATCH while the page was hidden, then visibilitychange to visible, refetched and showed the new headline. Offline passes: with /api/homepage aborted, cached sections (localStorage baked_hp_shop_CI) render with cms-offline and no crash. Switching modules MART->FOOD->SHOP->SEND(express)->MART keeps each module's branding; only SHOP uses CMS. Tablet: hero is 16:9 (1.78) at 820 and 1024, the product rail shows 3 and 4 cards, no horizontal overflow. However the category grid shows 4 columns at 1024 instead of 6 (bug). Admin Homepage Management loads, and the hero Slides tab shows the 'Tablet image (optional)' and 'Mobile image (optional)' fields.

minor.issue: Unknown ids are skipped silently but still counted in the 'count' field; no 404/400 for them.

ui_bugs.issue: At a 1024px viewport the grid shows 4 columns instead of 6. cols() gets the content width (screen - 32 = 992), which is below its >=1000 threshold for 6 columns. Fix: pass the screen width from useWindowDimensions to cols(), or lower the threshold to about 960.

design_issues.screen: Website /shop hero at 390px (existing website issue, not changed)
issues: Secondary CTA 'Nouveautés' is clipped at the bottom of the 16/10 hero and overlaps the dots indicator. The native version fits.
Labels are English (Home/Categories/Cart/Profile) while the rest of the page is French. Existing issue, for information only.

action_items: Fix the native CategoryGrid column breakpoint so 1024px tablets get 6 columns: use the screen width or a threshold of about 960 (then rebuild with npm run export:web).
Update the review request / docs: the Super Admin password is 'baked@2026#!$@' as in /app/memory/test_credentials.md; 'depex12345' returns 401.
critical_code_review_comments: _version() hashes id:display_order:updated_at of enabled rows. It depends on HomepageSection.updated_at having an onupdate; that works today (title and config PATCH changed the version).
useHomepage AppState handler sets offline=true on any version-check failure even when fresh data is shown. Consider only flagging offline when there is no fresh data.
HeroCarousel autoplay calls scrollToOffset inside the setIdx updater (a side effect inside a state updater); it can double-fire under StrictMode. Move the scroll into a useEffect on idx.
The api() retry makes 2 /api/homepage calls when offline. This is expected and harmless.
